2608.15165.title: SkillCommit: Evolving Agent Skills through Behaviorally Validated Scope Expansion
2608.15165.paper_summary: Large language model (LLM) agents can continually improve without parameter updates by converting historical experience into reusable procedural knowledge. However, existing methods often consolidate experience based on semantic similarity or LLM judgments, which may merge superficially related but behaviorally incompatible strategies and thereby degrade performance. To address the issue, we propose SkillCommit, an online skill evolution framework that continuously transforms experience into a hierarchical library of reusable skills. Each new experience is initially preserved as an instance-specific patch, retaining the behavior validated in its local context. As related skills accumulate, SkillCommit abstracts those sharing a common behavioral mechanism into higher-level skills. Specifically, for each incoming skill, embedding-based retrieval first identifies candidate related skills. Cross-instance replay and an LLM-based mechanism check determine whether these skills transfer across cases and share a common underlying mechanism. Candidates that pass both checks are abstracted into a higher-level skill and committed only if it preserves the validated behavior of all constituent skills. Experiments on RuleArena, OpenExempt and KOR-Bench demonstrate that SkillCommit consistently improves agent performance across diverse domains. Moreover, the learned skills transfer across model scales and families, enabling cross-model experience transfer.
2608.15165.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLM）代理可以透過將歷史經驗轉化為可重複使用的程序知識，持續改進而無需參數更新。<lb/>然而，現有的方法往往基於語義相似性或LLM判斷來整合經驗，這可能會合併表面上相關但行為上不相容的策略，從而降低性能。<lb/>為了解決這個問題，我們提出了SkillCommit，一個在線技能演進框架，持續將經驗轉化為可重複使用技能的層次庫。<lb/>每個新的經驗最初被保留為特定實例的補丁，保留在其本地上下文中驗證的行為。<lb/>隨著相關技能的積累，SkillCommit將那些共享共同行為機制的技能抽象為更高層次的技能。<lb/>具體而言，對於每個進來的技能，基於嵌入的檢索首先識別候選相關技能。<lb/>跨實例重放和基於LLM的機制檢查確定這些技能是否能夠在不同案例之間轉移並共享共同的基礎機制。<lb/>通過兩項檢查的候選技能被抽象為更高層次的技能，並僅在其保留所有組成技能的驗證行為時才被承諾。<lb/>在RuleArena、OpenExempt和KOR-Bench上的實驗表明，SkillCommit在不同領域中始終提高代理的性能。<lb/>此外，學習到的技能在模型規模和家族之間轉移，實現跨模型經驗轉移。
2608.15165.author: Yu He et.al.
